tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dus pa'i sgo nas gson gshin la lho sgo'i cho ga bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra dha ra ye/ 'dus pa'i sgo nas gson gshin la lho sgo'i cho ga byed mkhan mang yang*/ de'i bum chog med par khrus bum tsam dang*/ de yang mi byed par lho sgo'i cho ga mdzad pa dag gis rang gzhan bslus par 'gyur dogs nas 'dus pa'i bum chog bsdus pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ byung na ni bum pa'i bskyed chog cho ga'i gzhung ltar byas na legs mod/ dus kyi dbang gis byed mkhan dkon par mthong nas 'di bzhin byas nas mkhas pa'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal bar rtogs te/ de la yang lha lnga tsam byed pa dang*/ lha sogs gnyis kyi bskyed chog bsdus te byed pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar bshad par bya'o/ / de'i tshul ni/ bum pa mchod pa bcas sta gon byas nas mdun du stegs kyi khar bzhag ste/ bigh+nan+ta kṛd kyis bsangs/ shūn+ya ta nas haṃ/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ zhes pa nas ma hā tap+te swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā nas mi phyed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gcig zhes pa nas byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūṃ khaṃ zhes pa nas hūṃ hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ 'khor lo rin po che/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rim gyis lha so gnyis su gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la zhe sdang rdo rjes sku mdog mthing nag mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'khor lo pad+ma g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ reg bya rdo rje sngon mo'i mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/

shar du rnam snang dkar po/ lhor rin 'byung ser po/ zhes pa nas/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ phyi'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma nas/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma/ shar du byams pa dang sa snying*/ zhes pa nas/ byang du sgrib sel dang kun bzang*/ shar du gshin rje gshed/ zhes pa nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po/ lha thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rigs bdag phyag mtshan rgyan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon pau'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis 'dus pa'i lha so gnyis kyi ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lha so so'i rigs bdag yab yum gyi nas lha so so la dbang bskur bar gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod de/ nang mchod rgyas pa lha so so la'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rika sa pā ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ gis 'bul zhing*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ zhes sogs yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu na dang po tsam gyis bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa'i chu la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas sngags rnams ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum du bzla/ las sngags kyis gsang bar 'dod na slar bigh+nan ta kṛta lan nyer gcig gam bdun bzla zhing*/ 'jug tu yig brgya lan gsum bzlas nas mchod pa bsdus pa byas te/ bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /gal te 'jigs gsang gnyis kyi lha lnga'i bum chog bsdus pa byed 'dod na/ 'jigs byed la bum pa bskyed tshul sngar bzhin dang lha bskyed pa'i tshe/

rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ shar du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo nas ral gri des mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha lnga'i skur yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po nas g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum nas byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi phyag mtshan rgyan dang bcas pa'i nyams yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ yang na gtso 'khor lnga'i bskyed chog rgyas pa gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /sbyan 'dren gyi tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs zhes bya zhing*/ gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs bzhi la rnam snang sogs bzhis dbu brgyan par gyur/ nang mchod dang*/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe gtso 'khor lnga'i sngags tsam gyis chog cing*/ gzhan rnams ni sngar ltar bya'o/ /gsang 'dus lha lnga'i bum chog bsdus pa byed na/ bum pa bskyed tshul sngar ltar la lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan lnga/ de rnams kyi dbus su nyi ma/ shar du zla ba/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma ma/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus dang phyogs bzhir hūṃ khaṃ oṃ swā āḥhā/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dang rdo rje/ 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa lngar gyur ba ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas rig bya rdo rje ma nas 'khyud par gyur/

shar du rnam snang dkar po/ nas byang du don 'grub ljang khu nas nyams yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes pa'am/ yang na lnga ka'i bskyed chog gzhung ltar rgyas pa bya'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi tshe 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs zhes bya zhing*/ nang mchod dang*/ sngags bzla bar rigs lnga'i sngags tsam dang*/ yi ge gsum bzla zhing gzhan rnams ni sngar bzhin bya'o/ /'jigs gsang gnyis kyi cho ga la/ /brten nas gzhan don byed rnams kyis/ /bum chog gzhung bzhin ma lcogs tshe/ 'di bzhin byas na legs snyam sems/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ glang li'i dka' bcu ba 'jam dbyangs don yod kyis phyogs 'di na 'jigs gsang gnyis la brten nas lho sgo byed pa'i tshe bum chog mi byed 'dug pas khyed kyis 'di gnyis kyi bum chog byed tshul bsdus pa 'di lta bu zhig bgyis dang gzhan re gnyis la'ang phan srid ces bskul ba ltar shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du bris pa'o/ /par gyi yi ge pa yang dka' bcu de nyid do/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'dus pa'i sgo nas gson gshin la lho sgo'i cho ga bzhugs/ -PAGE 200--PAGE 199--PAGE 196-
